text: App: make the edit-item dialog full-screen and scrollable with the keyboard up

EditItemDialog is now a full-screen Dialog (usePlatformDefaultWidth=false, dismissOnClickOutside=false): fixed header (X + title), scrollable field area, fixed Cancel/Save action bar. safeDrawingPadding on the root + setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window,false) so the keyboard is a real inset and the action bar stays above it. EditItemDialogTest still green.
